title: Iditarod Sled Dog Kennel Tour Meet Champion Dogs in Alaska
blurb:
Explore the thrilling world of dog sledding with a guided tour at the nearest Iditarod kennel to Anchorage. Engage with champion sled dogs, learn about the life of a musher, and hear captivating stories from an Iditarod veteran in a cozy, heated yurt. This interactive experience is perfect for all ages and offers insight into the famed Iditarod race, making it an unforgettable adventure for families and groups alike.

- 1.5-hour guided kennel tour suitable for all ages
- Meet and interact with champion sled dogs and learn about mushing
- Engage in a Q&A session with a seasoned Iditarod participant
- Private group bookings available for a personalized experience
